_notice: Source registry + terms audit. Single source of truth, synced to the legal_sources table by `python -m app.ingestion.discover_sources`. Only APPROVED sources can be ingested. Decisions record what was verified on `last_checked`; they are an engineering record, not legal advice — have counsel confirm before commercial launch.

sources.name: Indian Supreme Court Judgments (AWS Open Data Registry, maintained by Dattam Labs)
sources.coverage: Supreme Court of India judgments 1950-present, English + regional; ~35K English judgments; bi-monthly updates
sources.license: CC-BY-4.0 (declared by the dataset maintainer on the AWS Open Data Registry)
sources.access_method: Public S3 bucket over HTTPS (no credentials): metadata/tar per year + data/tar per year (streamed)
sources.robots_or_access_constraints: Maintainers ask bulk users to prefer the tar archives over per-object requests, and to avoid high-concurrency scraping of the eCourts site. FormLaw streams the yearly tar archives sequentially.
sources.allowed_usage: Use, share and adapt with attribution (CC-BY-4.0). Underlying judgments: reproduction of a judgment of a court is not infringement under Copyright Act 1957 s.52(1)(q)(iv) unless prohibited by the court.
sources.restrictions: Attribution required. Accuracy is not guaranteed by the maintainer or the court registry (portal disclaimer: 'not meant for legal evidence') — users must verify against the official record.
sources.attribution: Indian Supreme Court Judgments was accessed on {date} from https://registry.opendata.aws/indian-supreme-court-judgments (CC BY 4.0, Dattam Labs). Original source: Supreme Court of India / eCourts.
sources.decision_reason: Explicit CC-BY-4.0 licence on the registry page; judgments are reproducible under s.52(1)(q)(iv); public bucket with documented bulk access.
sources.approved_by: Engineering terms audit 2026-10-08 (not a legal opinion; counsel to confirm before commercial launch)
known_gaps: Third-party mirror of eCourts data (authoritative: false); users must verify against the official record.
Only judgments published to the dataset are covered; orders and unreported judgments are not.

sources.name: Indian High Court Judgments (AWS Open Data Registry, maintained by Dattam Labs)
sources.coverage: 25 High Courts, ~17.8M judgments, ~1.25 TiB; quarterly updates
sources.license: CC-BY-4.0 (declared by the dataset maintainer on the AWS Open Data Registry)
sources.access_method: Public S3 bucket; partitioned by court (STATE~COURT codes) and year
sources.robots_or_access_constraints: Bulk access via tar archives only. Volume (~1.25 TiB) requires a server-side ingestion job, not a laptop.
sources.allowed_usage: Use, share and adapt with attribution (CC-BY-4.0); judgments reproducible under s.52(1)(q)(iv).
sources.restrictions: Attribution required; accuracy not guaranteed; verify against the official record.
sources.attribution: Indian High Court Judgments was accessed on {date} from https://registry.opendata.aws/indian-high-court-judgments (CC BY 4.0, Dattam Labs).
sources.decision_reason: Same licence basis as the Supreme Court dataset. Adapter not yet implemented (partition layout must be mapped per court); not ingested.
sources.approved_by: Engineering terms audit 2026-10-08 (not a legal opinion; counsel to confirm before commercial launch)
known_gaps: No adapter implemented yet: nothing ingested from this source.

sources.name: Constitution of India — Legislative Department, Ministry of Law and Justice
sources.coverage: Authoritative English text of the Constitution (PDF, 'as on' dated editions)
sources.license: Website copyright policy: 'Material featured on this website may be reproduced free of charge after taking proper permission by sending a mail to us.'
sources.access_method: PDF download (site refuses automated requests from this environment)
sources.robots_or_access_constraints: Prior written permission required by the site's copyright policy.
sources.allowed_usage: Only after permission from the Legislative Department.
sources.restrictions: Reproduce accurately; acknowledge the source; permission must be obtained first.
sources.attribution: The Constitution of India (as on {as_on}), Legislative Department, Ministry of Law and Justice, Government of India.
sources.decision_reason: Terms require prior permission by e-mail; none on record. Import with legal-data/constitution/import_constitution.py once permission is granted.

sources.name: India Code (Legislative Department)
sources.coverage: Central and State Acts, rules and regulations (exact reproduction of officially adopted text, PDF)
sources.license: No reuse licence published; site belongs to the Legislative Department whose policy requires permission. Copyright Act s.52(1)(q)(ii) permits reproducing an Act only together with commentary or other original matter.
sources.access_method: Web portal (HTTP 403 to automated requests from this environment)
sources.restrictions: Permission required; statute reproduction conditional on accompanying commentary.
sources.attribution: India Code, Legislative Department, Government of India.
sources.decision_reason: Usage rights for bulk ingestion unclear/restricted. BNS/BNSS/BSA texts therefore not ingested. The pre-existing IPC/CrPC excerpts in backend/app/agents/legal/corpus.py came with the original project and are flagged for the same review.

sources.name: Supreme Court of India website / e-SCR portal
sources.license: Not reviewed first-hand; site terms not verified.
sources.robots_or_access_constraints: Dataset maintainers ask users not to scrape the portal at high concurrency.
sources.allowed_usage: Use for manual verification of individual judgments only.
sources.decision_reason: The same judgments are available under CC-BY-4.0 via aws_sc_judgments; scraping the official portal is unnecessary.

sources.name: eCourts judgments portal (judgments.ecourts.gov.in)
sources.robots_or_access_constraints: CAPTCHA indicates automated access is not permitted.
sources.decision_reason: Automated access restricted (CAPTCHA). Use aws_hc_judgments for High Court coverage.

sources.name: Indian Kanoon
sources.license: Proprietary; paid API under its own terms.
sources.allowed_usage: Only under a signed API agreement.
sources.restrictions: No scraping; no redistribution without agreement.
sources.decision_reason: No licence held. Could be added later via a paid API agreement.

sources.name: Community Constitution datasets on Hugging Face (e.g. TheVixhal/Indian_Constitution)

sources.restrictions: Unknown 'as on' version; possible transcription errors.
sources.decision_reason: Not an authoritative text and the licence chain to the official source is unverifiable.
